question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneously spelled word is** "Maintainance".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **The wrongly spelled word is '***Maintainance***'. Its correct spelling is **'Maintenance'.**
 
• Maintenance means keeping something in good condition. (रखरखाव)
 
 
• **Example:* ****Mutual trust, spending time, and mutual Care play a significant role in the**** maintenance.***
 
 
 
• ***​ ***The correct answer is **option 4. **

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ***​******​ Meaning of other options: ***
 
• **Resourceful: **good at finding ways of doing things. (उपाय-कुशल)
 
• ** ****Illiterate:** not able to read or write. (लिखने या पढ़ने में असमर्थ)
 
• **Confidential: **secret; not to be shown or told to other people. (गोपनीय)
